description: This file defines the Flask application class, including methods for request handling, response processing, error handling, URL generation, static file serving, and application context management. It serves as the core of a Flask web application framework.

classes.name: Flask
classes.description: The core Flask application class implementing WSGI application, request handling, error management, URL building, static file serving, and context management.

methods.name: app_context
methods.description: Creates an application context, pushing current_app and g.

methods.name: request_context
methods.description: Creates a request context from a WSGI environment.

methods.name: test_request_context
methods.description: Creates a test request context for unit testing.

methods.name: wsgi_app
methods.description: The core WSGI application handling request dispatching and error handling.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: WSGI entry point, calls wsgi_app.

methods.name: handle_http_exception
methods.description: Handles HTTP exceptions, invoking error handlers.

methods.name: handle_user_exception
methods.description: Handles general exceptions, forwarding HTTPExceptions appropriately.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled exceptions, returning 500 responses.

methods.name: log_exception
methods.description: Logs exceptions to the application logger.

methods.name: dispatch_request
methods.description: Dispatches the request to the matched view function.

methods.name: full_dispatch_request
methods.description: Performs full request dispatch including pre/post processing and error handling.

methods.name: finalize_request
methods.description: Converts view return value into a Response, applies response processing.

methods.name: make_response
methods.description: Converts a view return value into a Response object.

methods.name: create_jinja_environment
methods.description: Creates and configures the Jinja2 environment for templates.

methods.name: create_url_adapter
methods.description: Creates a URL adapter for URL generation outside request context.

methods.name: raise_routing_exception
methods.description: Intercepts routing exceptions, possibly replacing redirects with errors.

methods.name: update_template_context
methods.description: Injects variables into template context.

methods.name: make_shell_context
methods.description: Provides context variables for interactive shells.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the development server.

methods.name: test_client
methods.description: Creates a test client for unit testing.

methods.name: test_cli_runner
methods.description: Creates a CLI runner for testing commands.

methods.name: ensure_sync
methods.description: Wraps async functions to run synchronously.

methods.name: async_to_sync
methods.description: Converts an async function to a sync function.

methods.name: url_for
methods.description: Generates URLs for endpoints.

methods.name: send_static_file
methods.description: Serves static files.

methods.name: open_resource
methods.description: Opens a resource file relative to app root.

methods.name: open_instance_resource
methods.description: Opens a resource file relative to the instance folder.
